title.zh: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
title.en: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers

current_state.zh: The CFTC expanded no-action relief for passive trading software providers, enabling crypto wallets and apps to facilitate access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.
